items.title: Investigation of Polymarket Insider Trading on the Reinstatement of Jensen Huang
items.summary: A forensic on-chain analysis documents suspected insider trading on a Polymarket market asking whether Jensen Huang would rejoin NVIDIA by December 31, 2026. The author says a wallet accumulated ~4,648 USDC at about a 6.5% probability, finishing its buys 89 minutes before Donald Trump's public post on the matter, then collected 71,518 USDC after NVIDIA's board confirmed the decision. The article traces the transactions minute-by-minute with on-chain hashes.

items.title: 2035 Came Early
items.summary: Blogger Farid Zakaria argues that the 'everything runs in JavaScript in the browser' future from Gary Bernhardt's 2012 talk 'The Birth & Death of JavaScript' has arrived years ahead of its 2035 punchline. The centerpiece is trynix.dev, built on his nixpkgs-multiverse project, which boots real GUI programs like Firefox, GIMP and classic solitaire directly in a browser tab. He credits LLMs with compressing the timeline that the joke once spread over decades.

items.title: Ladybird is now in alpha
items.summary: The Ladybird Browser Initiative announced the first alpha of Ladybird, a browser running an engine built from scratch rather than forked from an existing one. Downloadable builds for macOS and Linux are available as a rolling channel with regular automatic updates, and the team is asking web developers to test their sites and report breakage in-browser. The project explicitly makes no security promises yet and invites researchers to probe and report vulnerabilities.
